IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR=<TMPDIR>
# Set OOS_PENDING=false in ship-pr-state.sh
python3 -c "
import re
path = '$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/ship-pr-state.sh'
with open(path) as f: content = f.read()
content = re.sub(r'^OOS_PENDING=.*\$', 'OOS_PENDING=false', content, flags=re.MULTILINE)
with open(path, 'w') as f: f.write(content)
print('OOS_PENDING updated')
"
grep 'OOS_PENDING' "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/ship-pr-state.sh"

IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR=<TMPDIR>
export IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR
CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=$(awk 'BEGIN{p="LARCH_CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="} index($0,p)==1{print substr($0,length(p)+1); exit}' "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" 2>/dev/null || true)
export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT
export LARCH_QUIET_BREADCRUMBS=1

mkdir -p "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs"
_launch_id="ship-pr2.$$"
export LARCH_BREADCRUMB_STREAM="$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/ship-pr.${_launch_id}.ndjson"
: > "$LARCH_BREADCRUMB_STREAM"
export LARCH_DONE_SENTINEL="$(mktemp "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/ship-pr.${_launch_id}.done.XXXXXX")"
export LARCH_STATUS_FILE="$(mktemp "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/ship-pr.${_launch_id}.status.XXXXXX")"
export LARCH_QUIET_LOG_FILE="$(mktemp "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/ship-pr.${_launch_id}.quiet.XXXXXX")"
export LARCH_BREADCRUMBS_SURFACED_FILE="$(mktemp "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/ship-pr.${_launch_id}.surfaced.XXXXXX")"
export LARCH_PAIRED_PID_FILE="$(mktemp "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/ship-pr.${_launch_id}.pid.XXXXXX")"
touch "$LARCH_DONE_SENTINEL" "$LARCH_BREADCRUMBS_SURFACED_FILE"

# Tool JSON: run_in_background: true
# Background pair required: see BASH_AUTHORING.md §4
"<OPERATOR_REPO_PATH>/plugins/cache/larch-local/larch/42.5.39/scripts/ship-pr.sh" \
  --state-file "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/ship-pr-state.sh" \
  --implement-tmpdir "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR" \
  --merge "true" \
  --draft "false" \
  --forked "false" \
  --branch-name "sergey-zhupanov/implementing-aggregate-findings-attestat-2939" \
  --expected-session-id "$(cat "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-id" 2>/dev/null || true)" \
  --expected-tmpdir-basename-prefix "claude-implement-larch6-" \
  --issue-number "2939" \
  --manifest-path "<TMPDIR>/manifest.json" \
  --run-id "C91B8C3F-41CC-44E9-8C13-718205A84DEE" \
  --tool-label "codex" \
  --no-admin-fallback "false" \
  --no-logs-commit "false" \
  --repo "character-ai/larch" \
  --resume-phase "pr-create"

IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR=<TMPDIR>
export IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR
CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT=$(awk 'BEGIN{p="LARCH_CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT="} index($0,p)==1{print substr($0,length(p)+1); exit}' "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/session-env.sh" 2>/dev/null || true)
export CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT

sleep 3
LARCH_DONE_SENTINEL=$(ls "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/breadcrumbs/"ship-pr.ship-pr2.*.done.* 2>/dev/null | tail -1 || true)
echo "Polling ship-pr sentinel: $LARCH_DONE_SENTINEL"

count=0
while true; do
  count=$((count+1))
  if [ -s "$LARCH_DONE_SENTINEL" ]; then
    echo "ship-pr done after ${count}s"
    break
  fi
  if [ $((count % 12)) -eq 0 ]; then
    PHASE=$(grep '^PHASE=' "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/ship-pr-state.sh" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2)
    PR=$(grep '^PR_URL=' "$IMPLEMENT_TMPDIR/ship-pr-state.sh" 2>/dev/null | cut -d= -f2)
    echo "Still running... ${count}s | PHASE=$PHASE | PR=$PR"
  fi
  sleep 5
  count=$((count+4))
done
cat "$LARCH_DONE_SENTINEL"
